title: Wix vs Squarespace: Which Website Builder Fits You?
h1: Wix vs Squarespace: which website builder fits you?
description: Wix and Squarespace compared: design control, templates, ease of use, online stores, SEO tools, costs and when it helps to hire a specialist.
intro: Wix and Squarespace are two of the best-known website builders. Both let you build a site without writing code, host it for you and include templates, forms and basic store tools. They feel different, though: Wix gives you more freedom to place things anywhere, while Squarespace keeps you inside polished, structured layouts. This article compares them and explains when it is worth hiring a specialist to set up either one.

faq.q: Which is easier to start with?
faq.a: Both are beginner friendly. Squarespace is simpler because the layout rules keep pages tidy, while Wix offers more options and therefore more to learn.

faq.q: Which is better for a small online store?
faq.a: Both can run a small store. Compare the checkout options, shipping tools and fees for your country before choosing, because they differ.

faq.q: Can I move my site from one to the other?
faq.a: Not automatically. Text and images can be copied across, but the design usually has to be rebuilt.

faq.q: Is either good for search engine visibility?
faq.a: Both include the basics such as page titles, descriptions and clean addresses. Results depend far more on your content and links than on the builder.
Hire a specialist if you want a custom look, a larger store, many pages or a tidy setup of domain, email and tracking.
